name: dataflow
description: Visual data flows, envelope by envelope: editor (React), core (TS engine) and runner (Bun)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix editor install && bun install --cwd=runner && bun install --cwd=core && npm install
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd=core typecheck && bun run --cwd=runner typecheck && npm --prefix editor run typecheck
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm --prefix editor run build
